newsitem.title: USA: Banc One Capital buys Delphos Intl assets.
newsitem.headline: Banc One Capital buys Delphos Intl assets.

text.p: Banc One Capital Corp said on Monday that it has agreed to buy the assets of Delphos International, a Washington D.C.-based firm that arranges government-backed financing for international business.
Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.

David R. Meuse, chairman and chief executive officer of Banc One Capital Holdings Corporation, said: "We are completing this acquisition to make it much more convenient for our customers to operate on a global basis."
Over the past eight years, Delphos International has arranged more than $4 billion in government funding for more than 350 companies, he said.
Banc One said it planned, among other things, to develop several international mutual funds, targeting information technology ventures in the former Soviet Union.
It said it also planned to develop funds focusing on global medical equipment and health care services and small U.S. businesses focusing on Central America and the Caribbean.
